questions.q:
Should a person land the sr-25 fix under a class-2 decision, or do you accept the residual?
The fix must edit run/review.py. permissions-diff refuses any change to that file (run/permissions-diff.py:486), so an automatic worker cannot land it. report.md has the fix row, proven by the regression test on a trial commit, and the residual if accepted.
questions.why: permissions-diff refuses every change to run/review.py, and only the captain's class-2 decision lets a person land the fix. Re-dispatching it to an automatic worker would be cancelled the same way fix-sr-25 was.
